facts.text: The hotel is in Podil, described as the historical area of Kyiv, next to an embankment along the Dnipro river.
facts.excerpt: Discover the heart of Kyiv's historical area Podil, enjoy a walk along the wonderful embankment of Dnipro river

facts.text: The hotel has a wedding cake facade and sits on the banks of the Dnipro River.
facts.excerpt: With its glorious wedding cake façade and idyllic location on the banks of the Dnipro River

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the hotel as set behind a nineteenth-century stone facade on the Dnieper River in Podil.
facts.excerpt: behind a nineteenth-century stone facade on the Dnieper River in Podil, a lively district packed with bars and restaurants.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: unwind in lavishly decorated guest rooms or suites with plush furnishings and luxurious marble bathrooms

facts.text: Room decor blends contemporary comforts with heritage elements such as elaborate draperies, golden chandeliers, floral bedspreads and jewel-toned carpets.
facts.excerpt: contemporary comforts with heritage elements blend including elaborate draperies and golden chandeliers, floral bedspreads and jewel-toned carpets

facts.text: The Fairmont Gold Dnipro Suite is the only suite with a private terrace overlooking the Dnipro River.
facts.excerpt: This is the only suite that has a private terrace overlooking the Dnipro River.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold suites are located on the 11th and 12th floors.
facts.excerpt: Located on the 11th and 12th floors, our Fairmont Gold Suites, from 51-95 sq.m., offer an exceptional experience

facts.text: The hotel offers experiences at Elixir SPA Deluxe.
facts.excerpt: unforgettable experiences at Elixir SPA Deluxe

facts.text: SL Kyiv Casino offers gaming tables including American Roulette and Blackjack, plus slot machines.
facts.excerpt: SL KYIV offers fourteen gaming tables including American Roulette and Blackjack. 50 state-of-the-art slot machines
Our chefs will always find something to please you: from seasonal menus to magnificent meals that will satisfy any desire.

facts.text: The hotel hosts a movie night that pairs a cinema club with themed set dinners created by the chef.
facts.excerpt: Cinema club combined with thematic set dinners specially created by our Chef

facts.text: Indoor parking is available for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Parking available for an additional fee
